summary.text: Doc Kovaly, a U.S. Taxpayers Party candidate, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Michigan's 1st District to Jack Bergman.
Kovaly advanced from the party's convention on July 18, 2026.
Kovaly received 0.3% of the vote to Jack Bergman's 53.8%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.

sources.title: United States House of Representatives elections in Michigan, 2026
